title: Sequencing: manager briefings
bodyMd:
Five briefings take place in five successive slots. Each department gives exactly one briefing.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Finance, Logistics, Marketing, People, Technology.

- People must be in position 1.
- Finance must precede Marketing.
- Logistics and Technology must not occupy consecutive positions.
- Finance must not be in position 2.
